subject: Commercial path checklist — marketplace vs PO (pilot planning)
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@avasoft.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaSoft Procurement <procurement@avasoft.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps after today's pilot kickoff call

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of questions as we pull procurement and legal in:

- Pilot objective: 4-week evaluation of hosted inference for product search ranking (up to 5k qps peak).
- Success criteria: latency < 120ms p50, embedding quality comparable to our current model, and infra cost target <$X/token.
- Internal stakeholders you should expect: procurement, security (SOC2), and platform infra.

Questions for you:
1) Does Redwood require a PO for pilots for enterprise customers, or can we use a marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace) for faster onboarding?
2) We cannot use corporate credit card for vendor purchases — procurement prefers PO + net30. Is that supported for short pilots, or do you have a sandbox/hosted trial option that doesn't require upfront PO?
3) On hosted vs dedicated vs private: we expect to evaluate hosted first, then look at a dedicated commit if numbers look good. Will you be able to provide a short pricing sheet that maps: on-demand hosted, 3-month reserved, 12-month commit, and private (VPC) SKU?

I attached an internal procurement template (noted as attachment) and would appreciate a clear list of what your procurement team needs to proceed (vendor form, W9, SOC2).

Thanks —
Megan
Megan Liu 
Head of Product 
AvaSoft

Attachment: AvaSoft-vendor-questionnaire.pdf (procurement template)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@avasoft.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after today's pilot kickoff call

Megan —

Appreciate the clear recap. High level answers and next steps below — copying Aditya (pricing) and Karthik (procurement/partner ops) to ensure we surface the right artifacts.

Answers:
- PO vs marketplace: We support both. Marketplace purchases typically shorten procurement time (our marketplace listing supports subscription/commit SKUs and single-click purchase). If your procurement team prefers PO/net30, we can accept a PO for the pilot; finance will require vendor paperwork (W9, TIN) and a signed SOW for scope.
- Cardless pilots: For customers who cannot use a card, we offer a limited-duration hosted pilot on PO terms (pilot SOW + invoice). We can also enable a timeboxed hosted trial (no charge) for proof-of-concept under a lightweight trial agreement if legal prefers to postpone billing.
- Pricing matrix: attached a compact "pricing-options.xlsx" with on-demand hosted rates, recommended 3- & 12-month reserved commit tiers, and high-level private deployment (VPC/on-prem) pricing guidance including typical uplift for dedicated hardware and setup fees.

Clarifying Qs for procurement: please confirm whether AvaSoft requires vendor onboarding (forms) to be fully complete before a PO is issued, or if procurement can issue a PO conditioned on completion within 30 days. Also: is the PO for just the pilot or for an initial commit covering pilot + 3 months of production?

Recommended commercial path for your stated timeline (pilot in ~6 weeks):
1) Sign lightweight trial agreement + SOW (target: 1 week) so we can start instrumentation.
2) Procurement issues PO for pilot invoiced at pilot completion OR marketplace purchase to accelerate start (you pick).
3) After pilot (2–4 weeks), if signals meet success criteria we discuss 3-month reserved commit (discounted) or move to dedicated capacity for predictable throughput. Private deployment would be scoped later and typically requires legal/compliance review (SOC2 + network setup).

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, pricing-options.xlsx, marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf

I can set up a 30-minute procurement touchpoint with Karthik and your procurement lead this week — when's best?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@avasoft.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaSoft Procurement <procurement@avasoft.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after today's pilot kickoff call

Thanks Tessa — that all sounds reasonable. A few quick points from procurement:

- Procurement will only approve payment via PO (no credit card). They can issue a PO for a pilot but need either a signed SOW or trial agreement attached.
- Marketplace is an acceptable pathway and would likely be faster, but procurement prefers to own the PO flow for tracking — they asked whether Redwood's marketplace listing can accept a PO-backed purchase (some marketplaces support invoiced purchases).
- Timeline: procurement wants vendor onboarding items (W9, SOC2 report, DPA) on file; they can start vendor onboarding while the trial agreement is signed.

I am looping in Lynn from procurement (procurement@avasoft.com) in the next thread — she can coordinate the vendor forms. Please also confirm whether a 3-month reserved commit is eligible for a pilot discount (we typically negotiate a lower volume for initial pilots).

On quoting: can Aditya share an annotated pricing row that shows net pricing for 1) hosted on-demand (pilot estimate), 2) hosted 3-month reserved (pilot + initial production), and 3) private (VPC) indicative setup cost? If you can return that by EOD tomorrow it would help procurement align budgets.

Thanks,
Megan

Next steps: I will (a) attach the trial agreement + SOW for your review, (b) Aditya will send the pricing rows, (c) Karthik will share the marketplace onboarding checklist and contact for marketplace invoicing if you want to go that route.
